configdir.description: Directory used for storing Sylpheed configuration and data files

debug.description: Enables debug mode producing highly verbose console output

safe_mode.description: Enables safe mode where plugins are not loaded

attach_files.description: Default behavior to attach files to composed messages

items.description: Schema for individual account items in the accounts list

name.description: Account name displayed in the folder list

type.description: Server type such as imap, pop3, or nntp

in_server.description: Hostname of the incoming mail server

out_server.description: Hostname of the outgoing mail server

user.description: User login name for the account

in_port.description: Port number for the incoming mail server

out_port.description: Port number for the outgoing mail server

in_use_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS for the incoming connection

out_use_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS for the outgoing connection

local_folder.description: Local folder path for storing mail messages
